purpose: Compare prospectively frozen Layer-A structural warnings with sealed Layer-C full-context CPR mechanisms without translating monitor rule IDs into CPR labels.

matching.supported_match: normalized monitor object overlaps Layer-C event mechanism text or referenced semantic-node state and warning sequence is not after event end
matching.partial_localization: no core semantic overlap, but normalized monitor object overlaps frozen evidence preview bound to that Layer-C event and warning sequence is not after event end
matching.miss: positive Layer-C CPR event has no supported or partial frozen monitor localization
matching.audit_rejected_warning: unmatched warning overlaps a Layer-C NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY event in core semantic or bound evidence text
matching.unsupported_warning: unmatched warning is neither positively localized nor directly rejected

temporal_rule: prefix_sequence <= cpr_event.end_sequence when end_sequence exists; otherwise temporal check passes
publication_boundary: This is within-study full-context localization performance, not universal monitor accuracy or a claim that structural warning rules are equivalent to CPR labels.
